units.source_text: 回到自己室中，照例在佛前诵经。

en.t: Returning to his own room, he recited sutras before the Buddha as usual.

units.source_text: 直到夜半，就靠在白昼的坐垫上睡觉了。

en.t: He stayed awake until midnight, then leaned against the cushion he used during the day and fell asleep.

units.source_text: 次日，写信给明石夫人，内有诗云：

en.t: The next day, he wrote a letter to Lady Akashi, and in it included a poem that said:
